page_title: ATM 3-2 RSO | Atletico Madrid v Real Sociedad 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempts to find Goncalo Guedes, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
90+3' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90+1' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).

90' The ball is cleared after Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

81' 3 - 2 Goal! Matteo Ruggeri clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the bottom left corner. Alex Remiro had no chance of stopping that. 3:2.

81' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the bottom left corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Alex Remiro makes a save in the nick of time to maintain the current score.
80' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner.

80' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Atl. Madrid will take a corner.
76' A thunderous effort from long range by David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) goes well wide of the left post.
75' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro is well positioned and punches the ball away.

74' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Here is a change. Luka Sucic is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) coming on for Carlos Soler.
73' Adrian Cordero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick.
70' The attendance is 60788.
68' 2 - 2 Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
67' 2 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann tees up Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:1.
66' CHANCE! Julian Alvarez finds Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Ander Barrenetxea.
64' The linesman signals that Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
63' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
61' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Koke will be replaced by Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid).
60' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' Koke (Atl. Madrid) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
56' A substitution has been made. Orri Oskarsson is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
55' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Pablo Marin is replaced by Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thiago Almada leaves the pitch and Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
53' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) replaces Ademola Lookman.
53' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giuliano Simeone.
52' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
51' Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
49' Adrian Cordero shows a yellow card to Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
48' The free kick is delivered by Koke (Atl. Madrid) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
47' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Adrian Cordero signals a set piece. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
46' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Marcos Llorente.
46' The whistle blows and Adrian Cordero starts the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Jan Oblak stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.

45+5' A short pass finds Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
45+2' Looks like Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) heads on.
38' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Atl. Madrid! Play can continue.
38' There's a break in play and referee Adrian Cordero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Atl. Madrid using VAR. This could be interesting!
35' PENALTY APPEAL by Atl. Madrid, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
30' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
29' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
29' Koke (Atl. Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
28' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
22' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
20' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Adrian Cordero had an easy-decision to make.
19' Koke (Atl. Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
19' A pass into the penalty area from Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
11' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.

9' 1 - 1 Brilliant finish! Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Luka Sucic, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
7' The ball goes behind for a corner. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' 1 - 0 That's a GOAL! The long throw is precisely headed on by Jose Maria Gimenez to teammate Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who coolly slots home from close range. It's now 1:0.

4' Alex Remiro pulls off a great save to deny Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
